camel_example: aliyun dts CreateConsumerGroup --region cn-hangzhou --ConsumerGroupPassword Test123456 --ConsumerGroupUserName dtstest --ConsumerGroupName '测试订阅组' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SubscriptionInstanceId dtsg2m10r1x15a0000
description_en: Creates a consumer group for a change tracking instance
description_zh: 为数据订阅实例新增消费组
kebab_example: aliyun dts create-consumer-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsg2m10r1x15a0000 --consumer-group-name '测试订阅组' --consumer-group-user-name dtstest --consumer-group-password Test123456 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateConsumerGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the DescribeSubscriptionInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSubscriptionInstances接口查询
parameters.name: subscription_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the consumer group. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. We recommend that you use a descriptive name for easy identification
parameters.help_zh: 消费组名称，不超过128个字符。建议配置具有业务意义的名称，便于后续识别
parameters.name: consumer_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The account of the consumer group.

The account can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_). The account can be up to 16 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
消费组的账号。

由大写字母、小写字母、数字、下划线中的任意一种或多种组成。
最长 16 个字符
parameters.name: consumer_group_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the consumer group account.

The password must contain characters from at least two of the following categories: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
消费组账号的密码。

由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意两种或两种以上组成。
密码长度为8~32个字符
parameters.name: consumer_group_password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

ConsumerGroupID.description_en: The ID of the consumer group
